# 2 Baruch Chapter 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**1** "Yes, Adam sinned first and brought premature death on everyone. But every single person born after him also sinned on their own account.

**2** So every person was, in their own way, both their own Adam and their own Eve.

**3** No one forced Adam to sin — and still he did it. No one forces us — and still we do it too.

**4** And yet Moses told you: 'The command I give you today is not too hard for you and it is not out of reach.'

**5** Let me say it plainly: God's commandments are not beyond human ability. If a person chooses not to do evil, they are capable of doing good.

**6** The Law gives no excuse for doing wrong; nor does it give anyone an excuse for ignoring the commandments.

**7** But for the righteous, their justification has been guaranteed in advance — because the Law does not prejudge the innocent.

**8** If someone walks in the ways of the Most High and is not driven by greed, they will not die before their time. The Most High will not hold anyone accountable for more than what they actually did in this world."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. V.2 "their own Adam and their own Eve" — rendered as modern idiom preserving the striking parallelism. V.4 Deut 30:11 quoted in accessible form. "Greed" for "love of money" — same concept, more common English term.*
